hypothesis: Customer-level theft discrimination depends partly on across-window location, dispersion, tail, and extreme structure that a single mean, maximum, or attention-weighted latent vector cannot preserve; under the same SUMMARY_17 input and Stage 24B encoder, fixed multi-statistic pooling of learned latent dimensions will improve customer discrimination, and a classifier-matched direct-distribution control will determine whether any gain is attributable to learned latent behaviours rather than distribution pooling alone.

data.evaluate_once: DEV_VAL only after final code/configuration seal
data.eligible_windows: Existing Stage 3C usable stride-30 windows only

representations_and_models.definition: Stage 24B 17→32→16 encoder; fixed six-statistic 96-dimensional latent distribution; linear 96→1 head; train end to end with bag-level BCE
representations_and_models.role: Learn the encoder and report the minimal neural readout

representations_and_models.definition: Freeze each trained encoder, extract its 96-dimensional DEV_TRAIN/DEV_VAL latent-distribution representation, and fit the unchanged Stage 17B HGB on DEV_TRAIN
representations_and_models.role: Primary classifier-matched test of the learned representation; HGB feedback must not alter the encoder

representations_and_models.definition: Apply the identical six statistics directly to each of the 17 frozen SUMMARY_17 dimensions, yielding 102 customer features, then fit the unchanged Stage 17B HGB
representations_and_models.role: Crucial control separating distribution pooling from learned latent behaviour

neural_training.loss: Unweighted BCEWithLogitsLoss once per customer bag
neural_training.initialization: Xavier uniform linear weights; zero biases
neural_training.batching: Batch-local padding plus boolean masks; no padding contribution

seed_reporting: All five encoder seeds individually plus mean, population SD, median, min, and max; never select the best seed

comparisons: five-seed mean LATENT_DISTRIBUTION_HGB probability minus FULL_48_HGB
five-seed mean LATENT_DISTRIBUTION_HGB probability minus DIRECT_SUMMARY_DISTRIBUTION_HGB

all_required: Five-seed mean LATENT_DISTRIBUTION_HGB ROC-AUC delta versus FULL_48_HGB >= +0.010
Five-seed mean AP delta versus FULL_48_HGB >= +0.020
At least 4/5 seeds improve both primary metrics versus FULL_48_HGB
Paired seed-ensemble bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero for both metrics versus FULL_48_HGB
Mean latent-HGB gains over DIRECT_SUMMARY_DISTRIBUTION_HGB are >= +0.005 ROC-AUC and >= +0.010 AP, with both paired lower bounds above zero
Five-seed mean ROC-AUC delta versus FULL_48_HGB >= -0.005
Five-seed mean AP delta versus FULL_48_HGB >= -0.010
At least 4/5 seeds satisfy both parity margins
Paired seed-ensemble lower bounds exceed -0.005 ROC-AUC and -0.010 AP
Latent-HGB is non-worse than the direct control on both mean metrics and has at least one meaningful gain: ROC-AUC >= +0.005 or AP >= +0.010, with the corresponding paired lower bound above zero

outcome_criteria.C_WEAK_RESULT: Outcome A and Outcome B are not both fully satisfied; explicitly flag material inferiority when mean ROC-AUC delta < -0.015 or mean AP delta < -0.030

comparison_interpretation.latent_HGB_vs_FULL_48_HGB: Tests learned representation against the strongest classifier-matched conventional representation
comparison_interpretation.latent_HGB_vs_direct_distribution_HGB: Tests whether encoder learning adds value beyond multi-statistic aggregation
comparison_interpretation.E2E_vs_latent_HGB: Describes classifier/readout contribution; it is not a classifier search

abort_conditions: Execution spec or any Stage 25A source hash changes after sealing
Any required input count/hash/schema differs from the frozen development artifacts
Any CONFIRMATION or FINAL_TEST row enters a matrix
Quantile gradient, attention-free pooling, mask, single-instance, or padding-invariance tests fail
Any run uses an instance-level FLAG target
The 11-fit grid or five-seed reporting is incomplete
failure_policy: If Outcome C occurs, stop this neural representation direction. Do not add dimensions, depth, sequence models, more quantiles, attention hybrids, or hyperparameter searches without a qualitatively new external hypothesis.
